applicabilityBasis.summary: BabelFish XUSD is marketed as a 1:1 dollar stablecoin aggregator and cross-chain liquidity medium, but protocol withdrawals return underlying digital stablecoins with balancing fees. The opened documents do not establish an issuer legally obligated to redeem for fixed national-currency monetary value, as required by GENIUS section 2(22).

genius.notes: BabelFish documents XUSD as a meta-stablecoin aggregating and distributing deposited stablecoins across networks. Withdrawals deliver basket assets and can incur imbalance fees. Documentation identifies FISH governance and multisig-controlled parameters, without naming a legal fiat-redemption issuer or issuer domicile. Those fields are omitted, and DAO language does not establish a blanket regulatory exemption. The reserve-disclosure flag refers to published supported-asset and allocation-policy documentation, not a current independent attestation. No monthly independent reserve report, GENIUS issuer application or authorization was located in the public primary materials reviewed on 2026-10-07.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application or registered foreign exception was located for BabelFish XUSD or an identified legal issuer. Opened protocol documentation describes DAO governance and digital-stablecoin withdrawals, while official-domain searches and the OCC pending banking-applicant table did not identify BabelFish. Legal applicability and issuer identity remain unresolved; this negative review does not itself prove non-compliance or a statutory exemption.
